items.description: A single board on 4chan or 4channel and its configured settings.

board.description: Board directory short name (used as the path segment for all per-board endpoints).

name.description: Human-readable board title displayed at the top of the board.

ws_board.description: `1` if the board is worksafe, `0` otherwise.

per_page.description: Number of threads displayed on a single index page.

pages.description: Total number of index pages on the board.

max_filesize.description: Maximum file size allowed for non-`.webm` attachments, in bytes.

max_webm_filesize.description: Maximum file size allowed for `.webm` attachments, in bytes.

max_comment_chars.description: Maximum number of characters allowed in a single post comment.

max_webm_duration.description: Maximum allowed duration of a `.webm` attachment, in seconds.

bump_limit.description: Maximum number of replies before a thread stops bumping to the top.

image_limit.description: Maximum number of image replies before further image replies are discarded.

cooldowns.description: Per-board cooldown intervals (in seconds) between successive posts of each type.

threads.description: Minimum seconds between consecutive thread creations from the same poster.

replies.description: Minimum seconds between consecutive replies from the same poster.

images.description: Minimum seconds between consecutive image posts from the same poster.

meta_description.description: SEO `<meta>` description content for the board's catalog page.
meta_description.example: "/a/ - Anime & Manga" is 4chan's imageboard dedicated to the discussion of Japanese animation and manga.

spoilers.description: `1` if spoilered images are enabled on this board.

custom_spoilers.description: Number of custom spoiler image variants the board provides.

is_archived.description: `1` if the board has its archive enabled.

board_flags.description: Map of board-specific flag codes to human-readable flag names.

country_flags.description: `1` if poster country flags are enabled on this board.

user_ids.description: `1` if per-thread poster ID tags are enabled.

oekaki.description: `1` if users can submit drawings via the in-browser Oekaki app.

sjis_tags.description: `1` if the `[sjis]` Shift-JIS drawing tag is supported.

text_only.description: `1` if image posting is disabled on the board.

forced_anon.description: `1` if the name field is disabled on the board.

webm_audio.description: `1` if `.webm` files with audio tracks are allowed.

require_subject.description: `1` if OPs are required to include a subject.

min_image_width.description: Minimum allowed width of uploaded images, in pixels.

min_image_height.description: Minimum allowed height of uploaded images, in pixels.
